description: This file contains implementation code for ASN.1 objects related to Diffie-Hellman key agreement, including creation of ASN.1 sequence objects representing DH key agreement parameters. It defines functions for creating, initializing, and managing ASN.1 objects for the structure 'DHKeyAgreement', with methods to create child objects and retrieve their attributes and names.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_DHKEYAGREEMENT
classes.description: Represents the ASN.1 structure for Diffie-Hellman Key Agreement, including its properties and methods to manage its ASN.1 components.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscAsn1CreateDHKeyAgreement(ANSC_HANDLE hReserved)
methods.description: Creates and initializes an ASN.1 DH Key Agreement object, setting up its child structure and attributes.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscAsn1DHKeyAgreementCreateChildObject(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG index)
methods.description: Creates child ASN.1 objects for the DH Key Agreement structure based on the provided index (for 'p', 'g', and optional 'priValueLen').

methods.name: PANSC_ATTR_OBJECT AnscAsn1DHKeyAgreementCreateChildAttr(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG index)
methods.description: Creates attribute objects for each child ASN.1 element, though in this implementation it returns NULL and is a placeholder for potential attribute definitions.

methods.name: PCHAR AnscAsn1DHKeyAgreementGetChildName(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG index)
methods.description: Returns the name of the child element ('p', 'g', or 'priValueLen') based on the index.
